properties.description: Enter custom URL. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.description: Msg91 authkey. Accepts Hash Variables. Configurable in Manage Plugins / App Defaults.

properties.description: Msg91 Flow ID (e.g., 6100xxxxxxxx).

properties.label: API Endpoint URL
properties.description: e.g., https://api.example.com/v1/messages. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: from
properties.label: From (Sender ID / Phone)
properties.description: Sender ID or From Phone Number. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: to
properties.label: To (Recipient Phone)
properties.description: Recipient Phone Number. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: message
properties.label: Message Content / Text
properties.description: SMS / API message text. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: authHeaderValue
properties.label: Authorization Header Value
properties.description: e.g., 'Basic {base_64_string}' or 'Bearer {token}'. Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: payloadTemplate
properties.label: Custom Payload Template (Optional)
properties.description: Optional custom payload template. If left blank, payload is automatically constructed from To, From, and Message.

properties.name: headersGrid
properties.label: Custom HTTP Headers
properties.description: Add optional extra HTTP headers for ANY provider (e.g. X-Custom-Header, User-Agent). Accepts Hash Variables.

properties.name: customHeaders
properties.label: Custom Additional Headers (Text)
properties.description: Optional extra headers, one per line (e.g. Header-Name: Header-Value). Hash Variables supported.

properties.name: tableName
properties.label: Table Name
properties.description: Leave blank to skip saving audit log. Application ID is automatically prepended (e.g. appID_api_logs). Prefix 'app_fd_' is added automatically. Will save Method, Endpoint, Payload, Response, and Status Code.
